route_tag_rule.a_row_without_it: INVALID, counted separately, never included in a total
route_tag_rule.why: the tag is written by the runner (5ZG) so a row that ended up in the wrong file still names its route - and a row in the RIGHT file that does not name it is legacy's, hand-edited, or written by something that has not been taught the contract. None of those is Track 1 PnL.
